messages:
Sanjay: Heads-up — Acme wants a 2-week private VPC POC next month. Their ask: sustain ~400 gen RPS (mixed payloads), ~8k tokens/min per active model, 3 concurrent model variants. Region: eu-central. A100-80GB supply is sketchy there. Need a quick headroom calc + deployment checklist so sales can sign.

Marie: Got it. Quick clarifying q's: what's their average context length & target latency SLO? Also do they expect steady load or diurnal spikes?

Sanjay: Avg context ~1k tokens, SLO p95 < 600ms (prefer p50 ~200ms). Traffic will be bursty: peak windows around product launches, estimate 2x baseline for ~4–6 hrs/day.

Alex: Rough back-of-envelope: for our redwood-compat-7b-ish runner on A100-80GB w/ quant + batching, we see ~100–140 RPS at 1k ctx depending on batching. Use 120 RPS as conservative.

Alex: Quick calc/code:
```
assumptions:
- target sustained RPS = 400
- per-GPU throughput = 120 RPS
- desired headroom (for spikes + maintenance) = 1.4x
needed_gpus = ceil( (400 * 1.4) / 120 ) = ceil(560/120) = 5 GPUs
spare_for_maintenance = +1 => 6 GPUs total
GPU-hours for 2 weeks (336h) = 6 * 336 = 2016 GPU-hours
```

Alex: Cost note: if customer buys hardware, factor in utilization. If we bill equivalent cloud egress/ops, use 2016 * internal $/GPU-hr for estimate.

Priya: Network + host sizing notes: 6x A100s => recommend dual 100Gb NICs (bonded) to handle KV cache and large token outputs. Also provisioning CPU for decoder/IO: plan for 48 vCPUs and 256GB RAM per pod to avoid CPU backpressure. Watch for intra-VPC MTU and peering limits in eu-central — we've hit TCP window issues there.

Marie: Rollout suggestion: start with 1 canary pod (2 GPUs, config mirrored), run soak for 48h with synthetic traffic at 1.2x baseline, validate latency & tail metrics, then scale to full pod set. Add automatic fallback to smaller variant if underlying GPU alloc fails.

Sanjay: Ops ask: can infra team produce a one-page checklist for customer-run installers (network, firewall ports, NTP, KMS mapping, NIC drivers), and a short spreadsheet with GPU-hour & cost estimates? Sales needs numbers by EOD Friday.

Alex: I can push the spreadsheet template + perf assumptions. Priya will add network checklist. I'll include perf counters to collect (gpu_util, token/sec, batch_size, p50/p95 latency).

Priya: Also add monitoring alerts for 'KV cache miss rate' and 'batch latency > 200ms' — those predict high token egress and network saturation.

infra-bot: Deploy-checklist (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-pod-checklist — includes ports, kernel settings, nic tuning, and canary playbook. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay: Perfect. Action items captured: Alex -> spreadsheet + perf counters; Priya -> network checklist + NIC/CPU sizing; Marie -> canary runbook steps; Infra -> link + assist with eu-central hardware availability checks. Thanks all :pray:

Alex: I'll drop the spreadsheet in #eng-customer-assets in ~2h.

Marie: I'll draft the canary playbook and add explicit SLIs.

Sanjay: Closing thread once docs live. Appreciate the quick triage!
